title: 第15章 哟哪来的小白脸第16章 她从头到脚从里到外都是我的
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 孙悟空话音落定，便侧身对着江盼躺下，眼一闭，瞧着倒像是真要睡了。
江盼偷觑着他，又低头瞥了眼自己敞开的外衣，随后自己系好系带。
她鼻尖还泛着酸，忍不住吸了吸鼻子，睫毛上沾的泪珠颤了颤。
目光却不由自主地往他腰腹处瞟——
那哪吒的裤衩，她心心念念的目标，正被他压在身下，边角在昏暗中若隐若现，勾得她心头发痒。
【他当真睡熟了？】江盼瞥见石榻上还铺着层软毯，心尖儿突突直跳，
【要不……等会儿就装冷，手不经意划过去，借着拽毯子的由头，悄悄把裤衩抽出来？嗯，就这么办！
此计甚妙！
她打定主意，便颤颤巍巍往石榻内侧挪了挪，慢吞吞躺下，后背绷得死紧。
江盼试探着伸出手，指尖一点点往他腰腹方向探。
指尖勾到毯子边角时，她顺势往那边凑了凑，嘴里嘟囔着：“哎……好冷啊……我、我想盖盖毯子……”
话还没说完，指尖已经触到那片熟悉的布料——是裤衩的边角！
江盼心头一紧，猛地攥住边角，暗自咬牙：【拽完就跑！
可她刚攒足力气要扯，手腕突然被一股力道攥住，那力道不重，却带着不容挣脱的稳准狠。
江盼惊呼一声，还没反应过来，整个人已被他猛地一拉，天旋地转间撞进一个温热的怀抱，鼻尖正蹭着他结实的肩窝。
孙悟空睁开眼，朝她笑道：“现在呢，还冷不冷？”
江盼被他箍在怀里，前胸紧紧贴着他坚实的胸膛，连抬手挣扎的空隙都没有。
手还僵在半空，攥着裤衩的指尖因用力泛了白，脸颊“腾”
地红透，又羞又窘，结结巴巴道：“我、我……”
“我现在还冷得紧呢，我就是想盖盖毯子嘛……”
【完了完了！
被抓包了！
】她脑子里乱成一锅粥，【这死猴子根本没睡！
定是早瞧着我动静了！
孙悟空低头看着她瞪圆的眼睛，嘴角勾得更高：“盖毯子？”
他目光扫过她攥着裤衩的手，挑眉:“你这盖毯子的手法，倒是新鲜。
不抓毯子边角，偏逮着裤衩子不放？”
江盼手一松，裤衩滑落在石榻上。
她想抽回手，手腕却被他攥得更紧，那力道带着几分故意的逗弄。
“我没有……”
她慌忙辩解，声音小小的，“我就是、就是想拉过毯子……不小心碰、碰到的……”
孙悟空拖长了尾音，低头凑近她耳边轻语，“不小心能攥得这么紧？指节都白了，当我瞎？”
他指尖在她手腕内侧轻轻挠了下，惹得江盼瑟缩了一下，像只被逗弄的猫。
江盼又气又急，眼眶又红了，带着哭腔嚷嚷，“你放开我！”
“放开你，好让你再去偷那破裤衩？”
孙悟空低笑，手臂反而收得更紧，将她嵌得更牢，“小没良心的，刚帮你挡了牛魔王，转头就惦记着偷裤衩，嗯？”
“这裤衩不是你仰慕我，特意送我的吗？送出去的东西，哪有转头就往回抢的道理。”
content_en:
After Sun Wukong finished speaking, he lay down facing Jiang Pan. When he closed his eyes, he looked like he was really going to sleep.
Jiang Pan glanced at him secretly, then glanced down at his open coat, and then tied it up himself.
The tip of her nose was still sour, and she couldn't help sniffing, and the tears on her eyelashes trembled.
But her eyes couldn't help but glance at his waist and abdomen——
Nezha's underwear, the target of her thoughts, was being pressed under him, and the corners were looming in the dimness, tickling her heart.
[Is he really asleep? 】Jiang Pan caught a glimpse of the stone couch covered with soft blankets, and his heart skipped a beat.
[How about... just pretend to be cold later, move your hand over inadvertently, and quietly pull out your pants by pulling on the blanket? Well, let’s do it!
What a brilliant idea!
She made up her mind, then shakily moved to the inside of the stone couch, and slowly lay down, her back tense.
Jiang Pan tentatively stretched out his hand, fingertips exploring towards his waist and abdomen.
When her fingertips hooked into the corner of the blanket, she moved closer there, muttering: "Hey... it's so cold... I, I want to put a blanket on..."
Before he finished speaking, his fingertips had already touched the familiar piece of fabric - the edge of his pants!
Jiang Pan's heart tightened, he suddenly grabbed the corner, gritted his teeth secretly: [Run away after pulling!
But just as she gathered enough strength to pull, her wrist was suddenly grasped by a force. The force was not heavy, but it was firm and firm and could not be broken away.
"Ugh!"
Jiang Pan exclaimed, but before he could react, his whole body was suddenly pulled by him, and he was spinning into a warm embrace, with the tip of his nose rubbing against his strong shoulder.
Sun Wukong opened his eyes and smiled at her: "Now, are you still cold?"
Jiang Pan was held in his arms, her chest pressed tightly against his solid chest, and there was no room for him to even raise his hands to struggle.
His hands were still frozen in the air, and the fingertips holding his pants turned white from the exertion, and his cheeks "swelled"
The ground was red, and he was ashamed and embarrassed. He stammered: "I, I..."
"I'm still very cold right now. I just want to cover myself with a blanket..."
【It’s over, it’s over!
Got caught!
] Her mind was in chaos, [This damn monkey didn't sleep at all!
You must have been watching me for a long time!
Sun Wukong looked down at her wide eyes and raised the corners of his mouth higher: "A blanket?"
He glanced at her hands holding her pants and raised his eyebrows: "Your method of covering the blanket is quite new.
Instead of grabbing the corners of the blanket, you grab the pants? "
Jiang Pan let go of his hand and his pants slipped on the stone couch.
She wanted to withdraw her hand, but his wrist was held tighter, and the strength was somewhat deliberately teasing.
"I didn't..."
She hurriedly defended, her voice small, "I just wanted to pull the blanket over... I accidentally touched it..."
"Oh?"
Sun Wukong drew out his voice, lowered his head and whispered into her ear, "Accidentally, you can hold it so tightly? Your knuckles are all white, do you think I'm blind?"
His fingertips lightly scratched the inside of her wrist, causing Jiang Pan to flinch, like a teased cat.
"You..."
Jiang Pan was angry and anxious, his eyes were red again, and he shouted in a crying voice, "Let me go!"
"Let you go so that you can steal those tattered pants again?"
Sun Wukong chuckled, but tightened his arms, embedding her more firmly, "You little heartless boy, I just helped you block the Bull Demon King, but now you turn around and think about stealing your pants, huh?"
"Didn't you admire me and give these pants to me? There's no reason to snatch something back after giving it away."
title_en: Chapter 15 Where did this pretty girl come from? Chapter 16 She is mine from head to toe, inside and out.
